slides.title: What Happened
slides.body: BLS said producer prices (what businesses receive for goods and services) rose 0.3% on the month, a bit below the 0.4% forecast. Over 12 months they rose 6.5%.

slides.title: The Key Numbers
slides.subtitle: PPI final demand, 12-month change (%)
slides.body: October 2026, unadjusted. 6.5% is the highest since Nov 2022. *Excludes food and energy.

slides.title: Why It Matters
slides.body: Producer prices can feed into what shoppers pay later. Policymakers worry that fuel and tariff costs are spreading. Futures priced about 87% odds of a December Fed hike.
